description: This file defines the TwigPhpStorageCache class, which implements a cache interface for Twig templates using PHP storage and Drupal cache backend. It manages cache key generation, loading, writing, and timestamp retrieval for Twig cache files within Drupal.

classes.name: TwigPhpStorageCache
classes.description: Implements a cache storage for Twig templates using PHP storage and Drupal cache backend, with methods for generating cache keys, loading, saving, and retrieving timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a cache backend and a Twig cache prefix.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Returns the PHP storage object used for storing templates, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on template name and class, handling inline templates and sanitizing names.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a cached template by key.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Saves a template content to cache and updates its modification time.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the last modification timestamp for a cached template.
